weights: score = 0.35 x traffic rank + 0.35 x idle rank + 0.30 x performance rank (lower is better)

experiments.title: Daily setup: chain + rules
experiments.setup: Relay near the user -> exit in the US, two layers (VLESS Reality to the relay, Shadowsocks 2022 inside it to the exit), Rule mode: local domains direct, ad lists blocked, the rest through the chain. Same rule files in every app.

experiments.title: Simple setup: one hop, no rules
experiments.setup: Relay near the user -> exit in the US, one layer (VLESS Reality), Global mode: everything through it.
experiments.note: No full-speed test in this setup: performance is page first byte only.

experiments.title: Lab: loopback speed (trial)
experiments.setup: Every app -> a Shadowsocks 2022 server on the same Mac -> iperf3. Shows each app's own speed limit and CPU cost without the internet in the way. One round only: a trial.

rechecks.note: Anywhere 2.4 was rechecked alone on 17 Oct after the update: same lab and Mac, 1 round, with a profiler attached (adds a little CPU). Top download 4.1 Gbit/s. Idle was not measured.

chain_cost_note: A and B ran on different days. Where same_version is false the app was also updated in between (Anywhere 2.3 -> 2.4), so its factor mixes the chain with the update.
